mission_title: Breaking the Ring at Thorn Hollow
mission_subtitle: Relieve a besieged garrison before the ring tightens
situation_text: The Ashfall Combine has ringed Thorn Hollow for eleven days, cutting the garrison off from resupply. Command believes the ring is thinnest along the eastern approach, where the Combine's forces are still digging in.

objective_primary.text: Break the ring. Open a corridor to the garrison.

enemy_assessment.behavior_tag: STILL DIGGING IN, VULNERABLE AT THE SEAMS

reinforcement_note: No reinforcements are coming; this is the relief force.
assets_note: Command fields {parity} against a ring that has not finished digging in. The corridor will cost interceptors; expect the outriders to take the worst of it.
